description: Extract a website's design tokens as JSON: color palette with roles (hex), fonts and type scale, spacing, border radii, shadows, light/dark mode, and a ready-to-use Tailwind theme extension. Takes 5-20 s. Price: $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Without payment, returns the payment requirements.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
